program.section_heading: Art History - Associate in Arts for Transfer Degree: City
outcomes: Demonstrate knowledge of specific historical and cultural art styles.
Produce visual works of art reflecting global awareness, cultural diversity.
Produce visual works of art in a variety of mediums. Choose the most appropriate materials, tools and techniques to meet artist goals.
Solve basic problems of visual expression and describe its historical or contemporary context.
Interpret, evaluate and critiques orally and in writing visual works of art.

notes: The catalog prints ARTH C1100 and ARTH C1200 with a space; the closed list stores them as ARTHC1100 and ARTHC1200. They are treated as the same courses (catalog_addition false).

The outcomes are printed for 'the Art History Program' as a whole, and this A.A.-T shares them. The lead-in 'Students who complete the Art History Program will be able to:' is on the same line as the first outcome and was left out.

The third outcome line holds two sentences ('Produce visual works of art in a variety of mediums. Choose the most appropriate materials...'). It is recorded as one outcome, as printed on one line; a reviewer may want to check whether these are two outcomes.
The 60-unit degree total and the 18-unit minimum in the Award Notes are general AA-T/AS-T rules. The major total of 18.0 is the one recorded.
The page states Cal-GETC as the GE pattern.
